watch.en: Brown the surface in a hot pan, with the food dry.
watch.de: Die Oberfläche in der heißen Pfanne bräunen; das Gargut soll trocken sein.

why.en: Browning gives the crust its flavour. It does not seal the juices in: meat seared first loses about as much juice as meat browned at the end.
why.de: Das Bräunen gibt der Kruste ihren Geschmack. Es versiegelt den Saft nicht: Zuerst angebratenes Fleisch verliert etwa so viel Saft wie erst am Ende gebräuntes.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: is first pan-seared to brown its surface and enhance its flavor (through the Maillard reaction).

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Searing and then turning down to low is also beneficial when a dark crust and caramelized flavor is desired for the finished product.
